items.title: The Crow and the Pebbles
parts: A thirsty crow found a pot with a little water at the bottom.
His beak could not reach it. The crow thought and thought.
He dropped pebbles into the pot, one by one. The water rose higher and higher.
Soon the crow could drink. He flew away happy.
The lesson: when you think patiently, you can solve hard problems.

items.title: The Ant and the Dove
parts: A little ant slipped into a stream.
A kind dove dropped a leaf, and the ant climbed on to reach the bank.
Later, the ant saw the dove looking sleepy on a branch and tickled her foot to wake her for her dinner.
The dove and the ant smiled at each other.
The lesson: kindness comes back to those who are kind.
